articles.title: SpaceX Dragon Returns to Earth Packed With Science That Could Change Everything
articles.summary: A SpaceX Dragon is leaving the ISS on June 16 with thousands of pounds of science samples. It's carrying bioprinted organs, data for better rocket fuel, and materials that could lead to new cancer treatments.

articles.title: New Crocodile Species 'Lucy's Hunter' Was the Top Predator of Ancient Africa
articles.summary: Scientists have identified a new crocodile species that lived 3 million years ago in Ethiopia. Named Crocodylus lucivenator ('Lucy's hunter'), it was up to 15 feet long and likely preyed on early human ancestors.

articles.title: Lost Field Notebooks Unlock 55-Million-Year-Old Fossil Fish Mystery
articles.summary: Field notebooks from a late paleontologist solved a mystery about a fossil fish found in 1999. The 1.2-meter tarpon was a top predator 55 million years ago, and the notebooks provided the missing location data.
